visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a professionally lit studio with a grey seamless background, a young girl with braided pigtails wearing a beige knit sweater and a plaid skirt sits with her back to the camera on a circular yellow rug. To her left is a wooden minimalist house frame prop, and a white pillow lies on her right. (2) The camera captures her turning around to face the viewer; she holds a small wicker basket containing a round loaf of bread. Her facial expression is curious, and she uses both hands to grip the basket. (3) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of the girl holding a long baguette to her mouth, taking a bite while looking directly into the lens with an amused expression. (4) The editing creates a playful sequence where three similar-looking young girls in matching attire act like wolves, clawing their hands and shouting. They are standing on the same yellow rug in the studio. (5) A woman in a long tan dress interacts with the main girl, lifting her off a wooden step stool into the air and then bringing her down for a warm hug. The lighting remains bright and even. (6) The girl is shown from a side perspective, standing by a wooden table and looking at a tablet screen that displays a photo of her and the woman. She laughs heartily, her mouth wide open in a genuine expression of joy. (7) In the final sequence, the girl sits on the woman's lap in a different white sweater; they share a kiss and then celebrate by clapping together towards the camera as the shoot concludes.
